title: DSWD suspends AICS guarantee letter release starting Nov. 30; cash aid still available
summary: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) will temporarily suspend the issuance of guarantee letters (GLs) under its Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) program…

blocks.text: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) will temporarily suspend the issuance of guarantee letters (GLs) under its Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) program starting Nov. 30, 2026 to facilitate its annual liquidation process and settle outstanding payments to service providers.

DSWD spokesperson Assistant Secretary Irene Dumlao announced the temporary suspension on Monday, Nov. 23, clarifying that the measure will only cover guarantee letters and will not affect the distribution of outright cash assistance under the AICS program.

“Atin po munang pansamantalang ititigil ang pag-issue ng guarantee letters sa ating AICS upang mabigyan ng panahon ang Departamento na makumpleto ang taunang proseso ng liquidation at mabayaran ang mga obligasyon nito sa mga service provider,” Dumlao said.
“Kinakailangan po natin ito para masigurado na tuloy-tuloy ang serbisyo sa susunod na taon,” she added.

Dumlao assured the public that individuals and families experiencing crisis situations may continue to seek immediate financial assistance through the DSWD's Field Offices and satellite offices nationwide.

“Hindi po kinakailangang mangamba ang ating mga kababayan na nakararanas ng krisis dahil hindi po titigil ang outright cash ng AICS. Patuloy po kaming tatanggap ng kliyente sa aming mga Field Offices at satellite offices,” she said.
The issuance of guarantee letters is expected to resume on the first official working day of January 2027.
The DSWD urged the public to take note of the temporary suspension and monitor its official communication channels for further announcements. —LDF, GMA News
